title: Family chat encryption
body:
If a family message won’t open: wait a few seconds and try again, or open Family Chat on another family phone so keys can sync.

If secure chat isn’t ready yet: wait 5–10 seconds. If it still fails, open Family Chat once on another family device, then return here.

While we set up protection you’ll see a short “setting up” status — usually it finishes in a few seconds.
